versions.subject: Converted Sysmon/1 and Security/4688 to generic process creation rules
versions.detection:
selection:
  Image: '*\attrib.exe'
  CommandLine: '* +h *'
ini:
  CommandLine: '*\desktop.ini *'
intel:
  ParentImage: '*\cmd.exe'
  CommandLine: +R +H +S +A \*.cui
  ParentCommandLine: C:\WINDOWS\system32\\*.bat
condition: selection and not (ini or intel)
